P1para.Text: In this Order— “the appointed day” means 1st October 2001; “the Act” means the Utilities Act 2000;

Subject to articles 3 to 20, on the appointed day the provisions of the Act listed in the first column of the Schedule to this Order shall come into force for the purposes set out in the second column.

TitleBlock.Title: PROVISIONS OF THE UTILITIES ACT 2000 COMING INTO FORCE ON 1ST OCTOBER 2001

tr.td: For all purposes save in respect of paragraph 29 of Schedule 7
